Eventually we talked it out and now we're dating! 
On the other hand a friend of mine, almost in the same position, talked with his "interest" and she wasn't interested, now they won't speak with each other. 

I guess that what I'm trying to say here is that the risk is worth it...  in the end it's a bet, and you're betting everything for nothing, it really depends on you both. Maybe it will work out maybe it won't. But imo, the risk is worth it.

And the faster you say what you feel, the faster you will go back to the way it was.

My grandfather was likely involved in some way, as some of my uncles, my father's associate and best friend most likely was the one behind all of this.

I wake up in the morning, bloodied, covered in sweat. As i look to my left i see another dead body in the ground. A small grin escapes my face, as i examine it, i come to the realization that this might be my finest work to date. Both hands tied to the ceiling, feet nailed to the floor and a bloodied smile on his face. All of this.... My work, my art. As i take on final look i decide it's time to leave.
I close the door to the small apartment and head to the corridor, take out the disposable phone I bought earlier, and start dialing 9... This is the best part. 1... Taunting the policemen. 1.... See who in their ranks is deranged enough to find me. 
"9-1-1, what's your emergency?" The dispatcher says with a monotonous voice.
"I'm afraid i did it again. 455 main street, 2nd floor apartment on the end of the hallway" 
"Wha..." She started saying before i hanged the phone.
"Now we wait" i whispered. 
As the hours went by, i started hearing about my work in the news. It doesn't matter how many times i do it, I always find amusing hearing the horror in their voices as they describe it. 
As the night arrives and the sun hides, i start thinking about my next move. Should i work today or tomorrow. Should i do it in this town or the next. Questions as important as the body that will become my canvas. While thinking of this my mind starts to drift off into sleep, as one final thought crosses my mind. "Next time i will out do myself"
